idea-plugin.name: Farm Loss Notice Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Crop insurance claim form deadlines from 7 CFR 457.8 section 14: notice within 72 hours of discovering damage, no later than 15 days after the insurance period ends, phone notice confirmed in writing within 15 days, prevented planting notice within 72 hours after the final planting date, claim within 60 days after the insurance period ends.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Farm Loss Notice Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 9 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/farm-loss-notice-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/farm-loss-notice-lint
